text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar Pulai Jaya) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 11 November 2019.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar

Pulai Jaya yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Jambatan dan Lebuh Raya Laluan

Kedua Malaysia-Singapura, Lebuh Raya Laluan Pontian dan Lebuh Raya Perling yang

bermula dari kilometer 26.075 di koordinat U 173547.017, T 622725.578 Grid Bentuk

Benar Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di Had Sempadan

Penyenggaraan (HSP) di koordinat U 174405.145, T 622962.374 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000), dari Had Sempadan Penyenggaraan (HSP) di koordinat

U 174439.606, T 622967.824 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 28.275 di koordinat U 175543.479, T 623662.860 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000), dari kilometer 28.000 di koordinat U 175308.337, T 623526.531

Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di Had Sempadan Penyenggaraan (HSP)

di koordinat U 174436.662, T 623104.846 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan dari

Had Sempadan Penyenggaraan (HSP) di koordinat U 174403.699, T 623104.418

Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 26.025 di koordinat

U 173492.548, T 622732.304 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000), kesemua jarak diukur

ke arah utara dari sempadan antarabangsa Malaysia dan Singapura, termasuk jalan-jalan

sambungannya, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (BANDAR PULAI JAYA INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Johore, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Bandar Pulai Jaya

Interchange) Order 2019.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 11 November 2019.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Bandar Pulai Jaya Interchange which is

part of the Malaysia-Singapore Second Crossing Bridge and Expressway, Pontian Link

Expressway and Perling Expressway commencing from kilometre 26.075 at coordinates

N 173547.017, E 622725.578 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at the Limit of Maintenance Responsibility (LMR) at

coordinates N 174405.145, E 622962.374 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000)

Grid, from the Limit of Maintenance Responsibility (LMR) at coordinates

N 174439.606, E 622967.824 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending

at kilometre 28.275 at coordinates N 175543.479, E 623662.860 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid, from kilometre 28.000 at coordinates N 175308.337, E 623526.531 of

the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at the Limit of Maintenance

Responsibility (LMR) at coordinates N 174436.662, E 623104.846 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and from the Limit of Maintenance Responsibility (LMR) at coordinates

N 174403.699, E 623104.418 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at

kilometre 26.025 at coordinates N 173492.548, E 622732.304 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid, all distances are measured in a northerly direction from the

international boundary of Malaysia and Singapore, including its link roads, is declared to

be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
